messages:
Marco: Kicking off observability bootstrap for region eu-gpu-3. Goal: logs/metrics/traces + dashboards + alert templates. Need smoke checks and a handoff checklist.
Sienna: Copy. I added a minimal checklist in infra/observability/eu-gpu-3/README.md — follow order: manifests -> scrape targets -> ingestion -> dashboards -> alert smoke.
Marco: Applying bootstrap manifest now: `kubectl apply -f infra/observability/eu-gpu-3/bootstrap.yaml`
OpsBot: Deploy job `obs-bootstrap-eu-gpu-3` started (CI build 4421)
Devon: Heads up: initial `node-exporter` scrape failing on gpu-nodes-2 with TLS 403 from kube-proxy. Logs: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`.
Leila: Networking note: this cluster uses internal mTLS (sidecar mode). We need to add `observability-collector` CA to cluster-truststore. I'll push a policy change.
Ryan: Quick reminder — Loki ingestion has a soft quota by default. For GPU regions, we bump index rate to 20k/day. If you expect model logs >500MB/hour we should toggle the high-throughput config.
Sienna: Added smoke validation scripts: `tools/obs-smoke.sh`. It runs: prom scrape check, loki ingestion test, trace span roundtrip, and dashboard import verification. Run after manifests.
Marco: Smoke run output: prom scrape OK for kubelet/node-exporter except the one TLS node. Loki: push test log lines OK. Jaeger: spans visible with <200ms latency. Dashboards imported.
Devon: I fixed kube-proxy config (cert bundle) and restarted `kube-proxy` daemonset. Node exporter now returns 200.
Leila: Network change applied — annotate services with `observability.internal/trust: "true"` and the collector CA is mounted.
Sienna: Alert templates attached to the repo under `alerts/eu-gpu-3/`. Primary alerts we smoke test: GPU OOM rate, GPU memory pressure, node offline, long tail inference latency, Loki ingestion backlog, Prometheus scrape failure.
Marco: Example GPU memory alert I used in smoke tests:
```yaml
- alert: GPUHighMemoryUsage
  expr: (sum by(instance)(nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes) / sum by(instance)(nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes)) > 0.88
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU memory >88% on {{ $labels.instance }}"
```
Ryan: Suggest adding a cost control alert: `estimated_ingested_bytes` rate > X to catch runaway logging from models. We had a $1k/day spike last month in staging.
Sienna: Good call. Added `logs_ingest_rate_high` alert with a `warning` severity that tags by service.
Marco: Running dashboard smoke: index latency, tail sampling, and GPU utilization panels look correct. I updated threshold lines to match eu-gpu-3 baseline.
Devon: Prometheus targets: all exporters present except `csi-provisioner` on master-1 (readiness flapping). Filed k8s ticket #642.
OpsBot: Alertmanager config reload: successful. Alertmanager instances: 3/3 healthy.
Leila: For handoff, SREs need: grafana link, prometheus read-only creds, alert runbook links, and access to Loki query examples. I added those to the README.
Sienna: Handoff checklist partial: 
- grafana dashboards imported (yes)
- alert rules validated (yes)
- alert routing to oncall (verified)
- runbooks linked (yes)
- smoke run logs attached to the ticket (attached)
Marco: Cost note: enabling high-throughput Loki retention will increase monthly egress/ingest costs (~+18%). We can set 30-day hot retention then migrate old logs to cold S3.
Ryan: Approved for now — set retention and tag logs by `project` to allow per-team billing.
Devon: Final: `obs-smoke.sh` exit status 0. All critical checks passed except the small csi-provisioner flake which is tracked.
Marco: Great. Preparing handoff ticket to SRE with checklist and artifacts. Assigning to @Leila and @Ryan for post-handoff watch.
Leila: I'll take primary. Leaving runbook edits and alert severity tuning to Sienna.
Sienna: I'll follow up with updated thresholds after 24h of real traffic.
Marco: Thanks everyone. Handing off now.
OpsBot: Ticket OBS-HND-783 created and assigned to Leila, Ryan at 1951234720"
